rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=4, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0026, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.00025, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 feasibility onboarding (breast-ct-claude-agentic-itnet-v2-search-20260703-01, strict 20-min budget, re-split breast val=200). itnet_v2 on breast (512^2, 128-view fan, cheap geometry, NO per-sample-ps -> fast batched val). CONFIG seeded from the prior breast itnet_v2 TPE winner (search-20260521-01, hr 0.5385): itnet_k=4, itnet_alpha_init=0.0026, pretrain_lr=2.5e-4 -- BUT residual_learning FORCED to False (NOT the TPE's True). REASON: the Mayo v2 campaign proved CONFIG-default residual_learning=True DOUBLE-APPLIES the residual (SmallUNet defaults residual=True returning x-body(x), then ItNetV2.forward re-adds denoiser(x) -> ~2x collapse) and only False matches the working v1/v3 recipe; the prior breast TPE=True predates that audit -- flag residual_learning True-vs-False as a later one-knob test if hr underperforms 0.5385. unet_c=16 (conservative width), pretrain_epochs=15 with pretrain_patience=15 to disable the 1pct early-stop so the full budget converges, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200 (ALL re-split val cases -- do NOT exceed 200), seed=42. HYPOTHESIS: itnet_v2 at k=4/c=16/lr=2.5e-4 for 15 pretrain epochs on 600 breast train scenes produces a finite val_ssim that CLEARS the 128-view breast FBP baseline (hr>0) inside 20 min, establishing the corrected-split onboarding baseline that iters 2-5 will improve one knob at a time (pretrain_epochs, k, unet_c, lr, alpha).
